page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraving (a man bound to a stake amid flames and clouds) set within the page. No text blocks. A blue library stamp (oval, "NAPOLI") lies at the lower right and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page carries only an engraved illustration showing a figure tied to a stake with flames rising around him, set against clouds and a plain background. The engraving has no printed text, title or caption. The blue oval stamp reading "NAPOLI" with partly legible surrounding lettering is a library stamp and is left out.
